comment: The draft has a component for the individual at the point of care (CDSE) and one for the population in aggregate (HMIS). A third job sits between them: tracking one person's care commitments across systems and over time. No component owns it. We recommend naming this layer and placing the C1 capability in it.

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation

public.text: The draft has a component for the individual at the point of care (CDSE) and one for the population in aggregate (HMIS). A third job sits between them: tracking one person's care commitments across systems and over time. No component owns it. We recommend naming this layer and placing the C1 capability in it.
